definitions.explanation: The time at seven hours past midnight or noon.

examples.english: I wake up at seven o'clock.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}は{七時|しちじ}からです。
examples.english: The meeting starts at seven o'clock.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{七時|しちじ}に{家|いえ}を{出|で}る。
examples.english: I leave home at seven o'clock every morning.

notes:
READING: Both しちじ and ななじ are used for 'seven o'clock.' しちじ is the traditional reading and more common in set phrases.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{朝|あさ}{七時|しちじ} (7 a.m.)
・{夜|よる}{七時|しちじ} (7 p.m.)
・{七時半|しちじはん} (7:30)
・{七時|しちじ}ちょうど (exactly 7 o'clock)
